selectionGuide.title: Start with the bottleneck
selectionGuide.description: Pick the app that addresses the weakest step in your funnel or customer journey before adding more tools to the stack.

selectionGuide.title: Match the metric
selectionGuide.description: Define the metric you expect the app to move, such as traffic, conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchase rate, or support volume.

selectionGuide.title: Check operating fit
selectionGuide.description: Prioritize apps that fit your theme, data flow, team workflow, and current marketing or fulfillment stack.

rightFitGuide.title: Small stores
rightFitGuide.description: Prioritize simple setup, a free or low-cost plan, and features you can use immediately.

rightFitGuide.title: Growing brands
rightFitGuide.description: Look for automation, integrations, analytics, and plan tiers that will not force a migration too soon.

rightFitGuide.title: Larger operations
rightFitGuide.description: Evaluate support responsiveness, permissions, reporting depth, data handling, and operational controls.
